groups: Equipment Balance — Scarlet Cape Line Intelligence Buff:
Scarlet Cape: Increased Intelligence from 30 to 45;
Eldritch Scarlet Cape: Increased Intelligence from 40 to 60;
Abyssal Scarlet Mantle: Increased Intelligence from 50 to 75.
Bug Fix — Duplicate Tavern Visitors on Cold Start (Android RNG Seed Cloning):

Replaced ThreadLocalRandom and Kotlin's Random.Default (.random() / .shuffled()) with a lazily-seeded thread-local java.util.Random in Utils.random() and Utils.randomInt(), fixing an Android Zygote seed-inheritance bug where affected devices repeatedly rolled the exact same Tavern visitor (class and trait) on every app cold start.
Dungeon Balance — Malebolge (D13) v2.0 Rebalance:
Falling Rocks Hazard: Doubled AoE physical damage (20% -> 40% Max HP), reduced trigger chance in empty rooms (10% -> 5%), and increased stun targets from 1 to 2 distinct surviving allies (2 turns);
Volatile Slime: Removed turn-end self-detonation, increased on-death explosion damage to 40% Max HP magic damage, and extended ABLAZE & HELLFIRE durations to 3 turns;
Fire Hound: Increased melee counterattack chance from 50% to 100% and extended ABLAZE & HELLFIRE durations to 3 turns;

Ember Basilisk: Increased HP to 7,500, Threat from 1 to 3, and MP regen to 50; Petrifying Gaze now deals 200% magic damage (was 100% physical) with 3-turn ABLAZE/HELLFIRE and 20% PETRIFY chance, and basic attack debuffs last 3 turns;

Infernal Magma: Increased Threat from 2 to 3, reduced basic attack damage to 250–350, increased Magma Detonation active scaling to 80% target Max HP, and increased Molten Carapace death-explosion scaling to 40% target Max HP;

Banished Soul: Reworked into a rare solo-only encounter (3% of fights) with 4,000 HP and 20% Magic Crit Rate; removed Condemn, Ethereal Exile (flying, 1-dmg physical cap, and immunities), and added Screaming Wail passive (basic attacks deal 100% magic damage to all enemies with 100% 1-turn SILENCE and 20% 1-turn TERRIFY);

Lava Drake: Removed Hellfire Breath active skill and reduced DEX to 0; reworked Lava Drake passive so basic attacks deal 100% magic damage to all enemies with guaranteed hit and inflict ABLAZE + 3 stacks of HELLFIRE for 3 turns;
Molten Calamity: Increased HP to 10,000, MP regen from 25 to 34, and added immunity to SILENCE.
Combat Bug Fix — Stunned Healer & Angel Cleanse:

Fixed a bug where stunned or incapacitated healers (Angel, Archangel, etc.) could still heal and cleanse between rooms in enterRoom(), and where stunned Angel of War / Justiciar units could still cleanse at turn start.
UI / Quality of Life — Mass Egg Hatching & Auto-Set-Free Filter:
Mass Hatch Eggs Setting Toggle: Added 'Mass hatch eggs' (YES / NO, defaulting to NO) under Gameplay & Automation in Settings; when disabled, egg hatching retains its standard 1-by-1 behavior;

Mass Hatch & Filter Dialog (DialogConsumeEgg): When enabled, tapping Hatch on any egg opens a batch hatching dialog with quantity slider, 'Stop after keeping 1 pet' option, Minimum Trait Slots selector (2+ / 3+ / 4), and desired trait pickers for Traits 1–4;

Smart Egg Defaults & Ephemeral Reset: Filter settings reset cleanly each time the dialog opens, with Trait 1 defaulting to the egg's guaranteed first trait when unique (Decoy for Avian Egg) or 'Any' when the egg type has multiple possible first traits, and Traits 2–4 defaulting to 'Any';

Auto-Set-Free & Kept Pets Summary: Hatched pets that fail the filter requirements are automatically set free, while matching pets are added to the Shelter and listed in a clickable summary where tapping any kept pet opens its detail sheet.
UI / Quality of Life — Full-Screen Storage Overhaul, Live Search & Category Chips:

Full-Width & Full-Height Storage Viewport: Expanded DialogStorage to a full-screen layout where the item grid dynamically fills all available space between the filter header and the bottom Close button;
Live Text Search Bar: Added an instant search bar with a clear button that filters storage items by name, class, description, equipment effects/stats, and drop sources;

Horizontal Category & Sub-Category Chips: Replaced the collapsible vertical radio filter list with an always-visible horizontal category chip bar (All, Materials, Consumables, Weapons, Armors, Accessories, Relics, Runes) plus contextual sub-category chips (Eggs, Food, Potions & Vials, XP Tomes; Swords, Daggers, Axes, Bows, Staves; Heavy, Medium, Light armors);
Compact Sort Mode & Direction Toggle: Added compact header controls to cycle sort order (Type, Quantity, Alphabetical, Unit Price, Total Price) and toggle descending/ascending order.
Dungeon Balance — Malebolge (D13) Rebalance & Falling Rocks Hazard:
Volatile Slime: Both the 20% on-death explosion and 40% self-destruct now also inflict ABLAZE and 2 stacks of HELLFIRE for 2 turns;
Fire Hound: Basic attacks and counterattacks now reliably inflict ABLAZE and 1 stack of HELLFIRE for 2 turns;

Ember Basilisk: Reworked skills into Petrifying Gaze (Active: 100% AoE physical damage + ABLAZE & 2 stacks HELLFIRE for 2 turns + POISON for 5 turns + 10% PETRIFY for 1 turn) and Ember Ambush (Passive: acts first and starts combat with 100 Mana, basic attacks inflict ABLAZE & 1 stack HELLFIRE for 2 turns);

Infernal Magma: Reduced HP to 2000 and attack damage to 300–400, increased MP regen to 25, reworked Molten Carapace death explosion to deal 25% of each target's Max HP as magic damage + ABLAZE & 2 stacks HELLFIRE for 2 turns, and reworked Magma Detonation active self-destruct to deal 50% of each target's Max HP as magic damage + ABLAZE & 2 stacks HELLFIRE for 2 turns;
Banished Soul: Condemn now hits all enemies for 100% damage and inflicts SILENCE for 1 turn, while Ethereal Exile grants basic attacks a 15% chance to inflict TERRIFY for 1 turn;
Lava Drake: Reduced Hellfire Breath active magic damage from 200% to 150% and increased MP regen to 34;
Molten Calamity: Increased HP to 7500, reduced attack damage to 400–500, starts combat with 100 Mana, and increased MP regen to 25;
Falling Rocks Environmental Event: Added a 10% non-combat hazard in searchRoom() dealing 20% Max HP AoE physical damage (not intercepted by Angel of War) and stunning 1 random ally for 2 turns.
New Crafted Void Equipment — Absolute Despair & Void Mitre:

Absolute Despair (Dagger): Added new Workshop recipe crafted from 1x Infinite Despair, 2x Obsidian Ingot, and 1x Void Seal (retroactively unlocked for existing saves), granting +90 Constitution, +90 Dexterity, +200% Critical Damage, and 5% Max HP decay per turn;

Void Mitre (Accessory): Added new Workshop recipe crafted from 1x Eldritch Mitre, 2x Deep Sea Velvet, and 1x Void Seal (retroactively unlocked for existing saves), granting +90 Intelligence, +100 Max HP, +10% Skill Amplification, and locking Healing to 0% (cannot be increased by other equipment, doctrines, or traits).
New Crafted Weapon & Minion Relic — Scepter of Cursed Souls:

Scepter of Cursed Souls (Staff): Added new Workshop recipe crafted from 1x Cursed Scepter, 10x Tormented Essence, and 2x Obsidian Ingot (retroactively unlocked for existing saves that have seen any ingredient), granting +60 Intelligence and equipping summoned minions with Cursed Ancient Eye;
Cursed Ancient Eye (Minion Accessory): Grants +55 Constitution, +55 Dexterity, 100% Status Immunity, +20% Hit Chance, and 5% Lifesteal.
Combat Fix & Dungeon Balance — Malebolge, Avernus & Drops:

AoE Explosion Defense Interception & Soul Tether: Routed Volatile Slime (Volatile Burst) and Infernal Magma (Molten Carapace) explosions through centralized enemy AoE damage handling so Angel of War branch same-row AoE interception (Shared Burden) and Lich Soul Tether redirection properly apply;
Hellfire Meteor Rebalance: Reduced Ash Drake's Hellfire Meteor AoE magic damage from 230% to 110%;
Stonefire Roar Buff: Stonefire Minotaur's Stonefire Roar now also grants all living allies a 5% Max HP Shield alongside its 50% self-shield and 5-turn Taunt;
Avernus Encounters: Added a new 4x Stonefire Minotaur quad encounter pack (21 total encounter packs);
Chief Scientist Ava Drop Table: Added Chrono Echo Elixir at a 13% drop chance (adjusting Kaunian Fabric from 83% to 70%; Potion of Clumsiness remains 12% and Chief Scientist Coat remains 5%).
New Dungeon — Malebolge (D13 - Entry to Hell):
Volcanic Threshold Progression: Added Malebolge (D13), unlocked after 120 turns in The Sunken Citadel (D12), featuring 100 Darkness and unlocking Avernus (now D14) upon reaching 100 turns;

7 New Abyssal Enemies: Volatile Slime (Volatile Burst: 20% Max HP magic death blast & 30%/turn 40% Max HP magic self-explosion), Fire Hound (Magma Retaliation: 50% melee counterattack + 40% 1-turn HELLFIRE on hit & counterattack), Ember Basilisk (Petrifying Gaze + Crushing Strike), Infernal Magma (Magma Detonation 50% magic AoE + 1-turn HELLFIRE then self-explode into Molten Carapace), Banished Soul (Ethereal Exile: flying, physical dmg reduced to 1), Lava Drake (Hellfire Breath), and Molten Calamity (Cataclysmic Eruption summoning Infernal Magma);

New Drops & Refined Materials: Added Sulfur, Lesser Magma Core, Fire Hound Fang, Magma Bloom, Tormented Essence, plus Workshop-refined Sulfur Powder (5x Sulfur) and Magma Bloom Essence (10x Magma Bloom) alongside shared Infernal Hide and Emberite Scraps;

New Crafted Equipment: Added Staff of Tormented Souls (INT +50, Lifesteal 20%, ABLAZE damage +40%), Ashen Visage (CON +45, INT +25, 40% immunity to BLIND and ENFEEBLE), Brimstone Pendant (Darkness -20, 50% status resistance to ABLAZE and HELLFIRE), and Caldera Heart (HP +220, once-per-fight 100% lost HP AoE magic eruption below 40% HP, and 150% Max HP AoE magic detonation on death).
Combat / Bug Fix — Vagabond On-Kill Strike & Pet Fighter Assist:

Vagabond On-Kill Trigger Restored: Fixed a tier check requirement (tier >= 5 instead of tier >= 6) so Vagabond (Tier 5) now correctly triggers an immediate bonus strike against a random enemy on kill, aligning with its Perceptive Eye passive description;
Architecture & Performance — Weapon Skill & Combat Refactor:

AreaCombat Refactor: Extracted weapon skill resolution and execution (resolveWeaponSkillTargets, triggerWeaponSkill) as well as centralized on-kill handling (handleOnEnemyKill) into AreaCombat.kt, decoupling modular combat sub-routines from Area.kt.
Combat / Bug Fix — Bleak Disciple Instill Terror Darkness Scaling:
Vanilla v2.152 Parity Fix: Fixed a legacy bug where Bleak Disciple's active skill 'Instill Terror' had a hardcoded 100% stun probability, ignoring dungeon darkness;

Darkness-Scaled Stun: Stun application probability now correctly scales with local darkness (localDarkness * 0.01), matching its skill description and vanilla v2.152 behavior (0% stun chance at 0 darkness, 100% at 100 darkness);

Darkness Reduction Counterplay Restored: Bringing light sources, torches, and darkness reduction auras (e.g. Aura of Light) to The Lost Expedition now properly mitigates Bleak Disciple's turn 1 AoE stun.
UI / Quality of Life — Workshop & Market Queue Prioritization:
Press-and-Hold Prioritization: Long-pressing any queued item in the Workshop or Market dialog triggers haptic feedback and immediately prioritizes it to Slot 0 (Active Front);
Full Progress Preservation: Paused crafting and selling projects retain 100% of their accumulated elapsed seconds (secondsPassed), resuming seamlessly when returned to Slot 0 without losing work;
Smooth Animation Handoff: Active progress bar animators are cleanly transferred to newly prioritized projects while paused rows display their current static progress.
UI / Quality of Life — Team Select Equipment Swapping:

Direct Equipment Selection: Tapping an equipped weapon, armor, accessory, or relic slot on any slotted hero in the Team Select view (DialogSendTeam) now directly opens the Equipment Selection dialog (DialogSelectEquipment) or Relic dialog without needing to back out to the Adventurers roster;
Instant Team Display Refresh: Swapping or unequipping gear immediately updates the slotted adventurer's icons, traits, and ascended relic styling across the team view;
Safe Hero Roster Swapping: Tapping anywhere else on the hero card (portrait, name, level, or card background) continues to open the Adventurer Picker (DialogChooseAdventurer) as usual;
Anti-Duplication & Loadout Safety: Reuses the atomic equipment swap pipeline, preserving full storage safeguards, protecting active explorers, and syncing seamlessly with team loadout snapshots.
UI / Quality of Life — Adventurer Weapon Attack Stat Scaling Display:

In-Game Scaling Multipliers: Adventurer stat scaling multipliers (attackConstitutionScaling, attackDexterityScaling, attackIntelligenceScaling) are now clearly displayed beside basic stats (e.g. 'Constitution 115 (1.5)' or 'Intelligence 150 (0.4)') in both the Main Adventurer profile sheet (DialogEntityDetail) and the All Stats sheet (DialogEntityStatsDetail);
Non-Scaling Stat Suppression: Only stats with an active attack scaling multiplier (> 0.0) show parentheses, keeping zero-scaling stats clean and uncluttered;
Interactive Help Tooltip: Tapping any basic stat with an active attack multiplier displays the exact scaling ratio and weapon damage contribution percentage in the help panel.
Combat Balance — Armor Penetration Cap & War Doctrine Tuning:
Armor Penetration Cap (90%): Capped total armor penetration (Defense and Magic Defense ignore) at 90% across all entities and combat damage calculations;
War Doctrine — Tactical Knowledge: Nerfed armor penetration from 20% to 15% per level (30% max at Lv 2);
Sundering Trait: Nerfed armor penetration from 20% to 15%.
Adventurer Trait Rebalance & New Evo-24 PLUS Traits:
Nimble & Nimble+: Nerfed Nimble from 15% to 10% additive dodge chance, and added Nimble+ (Evo-24 upgrade) granting 15% additive dodge chance;

Troll Blood & Troll Blood+: Nerfed Troll Blood regeneration to 0.25% max HP per unit rank (+2.25% if ascended), and added Troll Blood+ (Evo-24 upgrade) regenerating 0.5% max HP per unit rank (+4.5% if ascended);

Dragon Blood & Dragon Blood+: Nerfed Dragon Blood damage reduction from 1% to 0.5% per unit rank (+4.5% if ascended), and added Dragon Blood+ (Evo-24 upgrade) reducing damage taken by 1% per unit rank (+9% if ascended);
Fortified: Nerfed battle-start shield from 25% to 15% of max HP;
Blessed: Nerfed darkness reduction from 15 to 10;
Nocturnal+: Nerfed darkness damage amplification from 2% to 1.5% per darkness;
Cursed+: Nerfed HP decay from 1% to 2% max HP each turn (retaining +30% lifesteal).
Pet Balance — Flat Combat Ability Scaling Buffs:
Fighter (×2): Doubled pet attack scaling from 0.5×level + 1 to 1.0×level + 2;
Healer (×2): Doubled pet heal scaling from 0.2×level + 1 to 0.4×level + 2;
Soothing / Regeneration (×2): Doubled party HP regeneration scaling from 0.3×level + 1 to 0.6×level + 2;
Protective / Barrier (×3): Tripled flat damage reduction scaling from 0.1×level + 1 to 0.3×level + 3.
New Crafted Medium Armor & Materials — Voidpiercer Jacket:

Voidpiercer Jacket: Added new Medium Armor crafted from 5 Obsidian Ingots, 1 Void Seal, and 2 Deep Sea Velvets, granting +225 Max HP, +25 Dexterity, +10 Magic Defense, and +10% Ignore Status Immunity;
Void Seal: Added new intermediate crafting material forged from 1 Eldritch Seal, 2 Void Cores, and 1 Trench God's Pearl;
Obsidian Ingot: Added refined intermediate material smelted from 200 Obsidian Chunks and 10 Astral Goo;
Equipment Immunity Penetration: Added ignoreImmunityToStatus support to Equipment and Adventurer aggregation so equipment bonuses stack cleanly with Doctrine abilities.
Combat Systems & UI — Flexible Status Immunity & Status Resistance:

Flexible Specific Status Immunity (0%–100%): Upgraded specific status immunities on Entities and Equipment from binary 100% flags to percentage-based values (addStatusImmunity(type, chance)), rolling separately from General Status Immunity on status application;

General & Specific Status Resistance (0%–100%): Added general and per-status resistance on Entities and Equipment. Reduces incoming damage from DoT statuses (Ablaze, Hellfire, Bloodflame, Bleed, Frozen, Entangle, Terrify) and Thorns recoil after attacker gear bonuses, dealing 0 damage at 100% resistance;

Crowd-Control Self-Cleanse on Turn: Units afflicted by cleansable CC (Stun, Petrify, Silence, Terrify, Confuse) roll General and Specific Status Resistance separately at the start of their turn to break free and act normally (Terrify ticks its reduced DoT before rolling to break free; uncleansable stuns and soft CCs Entangle/Frozen do not self-cleanse);

Entity Stats Detail — Status Defense Stat Section: Added a dedicated 2-column Status Defense Stat section between Defense Stat and Utility Stat, displaying General and Specific Status Immunities (left column) alongside General and Specific Status Resistances (right column).
Balance & Progression — Sunken Citadel (D12) Equipment Stat Rebalance:
Coral Armor & Helmet Tuning: Coral Armor Max HP tuned from 400 to 350; Coral Helmet Max HP adjusted from 270 to 250;

Coral Weapons & Boots Rebalance: Coral Axe buffed to +35 CON / +35 INT (from 30/20). Coral Bow rebalanced to +35 DEX / +13 INT (from 50 DEX). Coral Staff adjusted to +45 INT (from 60). Coral Boots tuned to +35 DEX while significantly buffing underwater attack speed drag reduction to 50% (from 30%);
Shark Weapons Tuning: Shark Dagger adjusted to +35 CON / +35 DEX with +20% Physical Crit Damage (from +40%). Shark Sword adjusted to +35 CON / +13 DEX with +20% Physical Crit Damage (from +40%);
Siren Coral Combat Robe: Rebalanced defensive and offensive stats to +55 Constitution and +35 Intelligence (from 60/50).
New Dungeon & Progression — Avernus (D13 - Intellectual Volcanic Domain):
Subterranean Volcanic Domain: Added Avernus (D13), unlocked upon completing 120 turns in The Sunken Citadel (D12). Features 30 Darkness, deep volcanic canyons, and fortified basalt bastions;

Environmental Hazards: Native Choking Ash has a 15% chance to inflict BLIND and ENFEEBLE on acting adventurers. Unavoidable Magma Crust Eruptions have an 8% chance to deal 10% Max HP direct damage (min 50) and inflict ABLAZE;

6 Civilized & Demonic Foes: Battle disciplined Stonefire Goblins, flying Brimstone Imps, ritualistic Hellfire Cultists (inflicting stackable Hellfire), frontline Stonefire Minotaurs (taunt roar + 50% shield), Basalt Colossuses, and the apex Ash Drake [Elite] (Hellfire Meteor + Ashen Ambush);

New Crafting & Equipment Progression: Introduced 8 volcanic materials (Emberite Scraps/Ingot, Infernal Hide/Leather, Infernal Fabric, Stonefire Minotaur Horn, Ashen Scale, Greater Magma Core) and 13 new equipment items across weapons, the full armor trinity, and accessories including the Tier 4 Icon of Torment.
New Endgame Accessory & Crafting — Electric Violin:
Electric Violin Crafted Accessory: Added Electric Violin, a high-tier bard accessory crafted by combining Cosmic Violin + Voltaic Shock in the Workshop;
Stats & Bonuses: Provides +30 Constitution, +35 Dexterity, +35 Intelligence, and extends Inspire/Exalt durations by +4 turns;
Voltaic Resonance Bonus Action: Deals 150 flat damage with a 14% chance to STUN the target at the end of each turn;
Retroactive Discovery: Automatically discovered in the Workshop recipe list if either Cosmic Violin or Voltaic Shock has been encountered.
Quality of Life & Settings — Load Team Equipment Loadout Toggle:
Team Gear Loadout Setting: Added a user setting in Settings (under Gameplay & Automation): 'Equip saved gear on Load Team' (YES / NO, defaulting to YES);

Non-Destructive Loadout Preservation: Saving a team continues to silently snapshot heroes' equipped gear into Area.savedAdventurersGear regardless of the toggle, ensuring no presets are lost or overwritten;

Flexible Early-Game Gearing: When toggled to NO, pressing Load Team loads the team composition and pet while leaving heroes' current equipment 100% untouched, preventing early-game equipment downgrades from older presets;
Auto-Raid Integration: Auto-Raid respects this setting, preserving adventurers' equipped gear across automated runs when the toggle is disabled.
Combat Engine & Enemy Balancing — Attack Speed & End-of-Turn Actions Architectural Overhaul:

Enemy Polymorphic Dispatch Fix: Re-architected Enemy.endOfTurnActions(currentArea) to cache boundArea and delegate directly to endOfTurnActions(), ensuring enemy subclass overrides (Imperial Captain, Leviathan Hatchling, Dreamwrought Swarm) are executed properly during combat turns;

Unified Enemy Attack Speed Pipeline: Introduced getBaseAttackSpeed(): Int in Enemy.kt to allow enemy units to define intrinsic attack speeds that propagate cleanly through combat formulas, area environmental modifiers, debuffs, and UI dialogs;

Celestial Destroyer Tuning: Buffed Celestial Destroyer to 600% Attack Speed (1 basic attack + 5 extra attacks = 6 hits per turn), modernizing its Flying Fortress barrage onto the unified attack speed system with full dynamic target selection per strike;

Headless Knight Parity: Aligned Headless Knight with 300% Attack Speed (1 basic attack + 2 extra attacks = 3 hits per turn) and removed legacy customEndOfTurnActions to eliminate multi-layer action duplication;
Leviathan Hatchling Transparency: Replaced generic Deflect Magic with dedicated passive Benthic Deflection (20% magic deflection) and retired the obsolete Benthic Geyser;
Abyssal Sovereign Deflection: Granted Leviathan 40% magic deflection under Abyssal Sovereign, aligning with Leviathan Hatchling's 20% deflection mechanism.
Combat Engine & Itemization — Specialized Critical Damage Scaling Fix:

Ruthless & Ruthless+ Scaling Parity: Fixed an issue where equipment with specialized physical or spell critical damage bonuses (e.g. Abyssal Chitin Dagger, Shark Dagger, Shark Sword) bypassed the multiplicative scaling of Ruthless (+20%) and Ruthless+ (+30%);

Unified Critical Strike Architecture: Decomposed critical strike calculations into clean, domain-specific base, equipment, and modifier pipelines across Adventurer, ensuring consistent scaling and eliminating fragile delta arithmetic.
Combat Engine — Pet Status Effect Pipeline Consolidation:
Unified Pipeline Routing: Refactored petCast() in Area to route both positive and negative pet status effects directly through the centralized applyStatus() method;
Immunity Compliance: Ensured pet debuffs strictly respect target status immunities and trigger standardized combat logging and effect handling.
Adventurer Balancing & Mechanics — Angel of War Branch Tuning:

Same-Row Radiant Blessing: Restructured the Holy Knight -> Angel of War evolution line (T4 Holy Knight through T9 Angel of War) so that the Radiant Blessing aura is granted exclusively to allies in the same row rather than party-wide. Each row evaluates its aura independently using the highest alive tier present in that row;
Overheal Shield Removal: Removed the overheal-to-shield conversion from Angel of War's basic attack heal (radiantHealLowest), cleanly discarding healing that overflows past max HP;

Aura of the Seraphim Turn-Start Cleanse Tuning: Nerfed the turn-start debuff cleansing on PASSIVE_AURA_OF_THE_SERAPHIM to cleanse 1 negative effect from the single most debuffed ally (matching Justiciar's Aura of Sanctity) rather than cleansing every ally in the party;

Skill Description Consistency: Updated strings.xml across all 6 branch aura tiers to specify same-row targeting, and updated Aura of the Seraphim to document the single-target cleanse and the removal of the overheal shield.
Adventurer Progression & Utility — Chrono Echo Elixir:

Chrono Echo Elixir: Added the Chrono Echo Elixir consumable, allowing adventurers to unweave and reset all 11 consumed stat potions back to zero, refunding full potion drinking capacity for build re-specialization;
Safe Reset Dialog: Implemented DialogConsumeChronoEchoElixir with confirmation prompts, filtering the list to display only adventurers who have consumed at least one potion;

Prototype Weapons Suite: Introduced experimental Prototype Sword, Prototype Bow, and Prototype Dagger testing armaments with extreme scaling values and standardized uppercase status effect formatting (STUN, ABLAZE, FREEZE, POISON, SILENCE).
Raid Progression & Save Integrity — Hadal Abyss Re-Locking:

Retroactive Requirement Validation: Enforced strict validation during save deserialization so that The Hadal Abyss is re-locked if the save has not met the canonical requirement of defeating 10 Leviathan Hatchlings (leviathanHatchlingKills < 10);

Exploration Party Safety Evacuation: When re-locking The Hadal Abyss on an existing save, any party actively exploring or configured for the raid is cleanly recalled to the guild, ensuring adventurers are never stranded in an inaccessible raid.
Sunken Citadel Equipment Rebalance & Progression Fix:
Coral Armor Retaliation: Increased Coral Armor physical retaliation damage from 15 to 45 for improved defensive scaling;

Deep-Sea Weapons Rebalance: Adjusted Coral Axe stats (Con 40 -> 30, Int 30 -> 20), Coral Bow stats (Dex 70 -> 50, attack speed drag reduction improved from 50% to 60%), Coral Staff (Int 70 -> 60), and Shark Sword (Con 65 -> 45);
Siren Coral Combat Robe: Adjusted intelligence from 60 to 50 for balanced caster itemization;
Hadal Abyss Unlock Milestone Removal: Removed the 100-room milestone unlock from The Sunken Citadel, strictly adhering to the intended unlock requirement of defeating 10 Leviathan Hatchlings.
Pinnacle Raid Lifecycle & Post-Boss Progression Fix:

Authoritative Raid Termination: Rebuilt raid conclusion logic in The Hadal Abyss and Sanguine Crucible to rely on authoritative, persisted room progress (progress > maxRooms) rather than a fragile in-memory transient boolean (bossDefeated);

Infinite Mob Farming Prevention: Fixed a bug in The Hadal Abyss where rollEnemies() fell through to an unconstrained else branch on room 13+, causing parties to endlessly clear rooms (74+ areas) farming normal corridor mobs after defeating the Leviathan;

Sanguine Crucible Boss Re-Fight Prevention: Fixed a bug in Sanguine Crucible where progress >= ev.progress could re-roll and respawn Archmagus Valthex and his acolytes if the app was closed, backgrounded, or processed offline progress between the boss kill and next room entry;

State Persistence Resilience: Both pinnacle raids now cleanly and synchronously set terminationRequested upon entering post-boss rooms (progress >= 13 in Hadal Abyss; progress > event.progress in Sanguine Crucible), guaranteeing proper completion, drops, and return to guild even across app restarts and offline simulation.
Combat & Summoning — Allied Field Capacity & Log Notifications:

Allied Field Cap Enforcement: Enforced a strict 15-unit maximum limit on allied combatants in Area.kt (Area.MAX_ALLIED_UNITS = 15), matching the UI's 15 unit frames in DialogDungeonDetail and eliminating ghost units that acted in combat without visual representation;

Necromancer & Lich Summon Cap: Blocked spawnMinionForLich() from exceeding 15 units; in handleCurseSkillSummonOrHeal(), casting Curse when the battlefield is full now cleanly heals active bound minions rather than failing without benefit;
Beast Tamer Turn Spam Protection: Added transient deduplication to spawnMinionForBeastTamer() so the Beast Tamer does not flood the battle log with capacity warnings every combat turn;
Dynamic Slot Reclamation: When an active minion or ally dies in combat, the 15th slot is immediately freed, resetting notification flags and allowing new summons to take their place;
Battlefield Capacity Combat Log: Added Logger.SUMMON_FAILED_CAPACITY (code 140) and log_summon_failed_capacity to inform the player when a summon fails due to full party capacity.
Item & Environmental Balancing — Tidal Lantern Illumination:
Tidal Lantern Darkness Reduction: Configured TidalLantern with 10 darkness reduction (TidalLantern.DARKNESS_REDUCTION_AMOUNT = 10);

Non-Stacking Illumination Aura: In Area.kt, multiple Tidal Lanterns equipped across different adventurers in the same expedition party are deduplicated so the item provides exactly 10 darkness reduction total rather than compounding;
Item Effect Description: Updated accessory_tidal_lantern_effect to clearly display '-10 darkness (does not stack)'.
Archer & Celestial Rain Combat Rebalance — Keen Vision Overhaul:

Active Skill Guaranteed Hit: All units in the Marksman / Celestial Rain branch (Marksman, Sureshot, Fury, Hailstorm, Tempest, Hurricane, Celestial Rain) now have guaranteed hit accuracy on active skills via Keen Vision, ensuring all 11 arrows of Barrage VIII land unerringly without being dodged or lost to darkness;
Armor Penetration: Keen Vision now grants +10% enemy armor penetration across all attacks, reducing enemy effective defense and boosting physical multi-hit barrage scaling against armored targets;
Unified Critical Scaling: Keen Vision now increases both Physical and Spell Critical Strike Chance (+10%) and Damage (+25%), bolstering hybrid and magic-equipped archer builds;
Preserved Basic Attack Evasion Counterplay: Basic attacks retain the standard +30% hit chance bonus, maintaining interactive evasion, darkness, and dodge mechanics during normal turns.
New Corrupted Dungeon — Corrupted Desert:

Corrupted Desert Added: The second corrupted dungeon area is now available in the Corrupted Dungeons tab, featuring maximum darkness 10, independent expedition management, and a 10-wave Corrupted Shahuri Army assault event on reaching 100 kills;

Corrupted Desert Denizens: Introduces 6 new corrupted enemy variants with doubled baseline statistics and EXP rewards — Corrupted Vulture, Corrupted Sha'huri Warrior, Corrupted Sha'huri Archer, Corrupted Sha'huri Mage, Corrupted Sha'Kire, and the awakened avatar Corrupted Sha;

Corrupted Sha Encounter: Slaying Corrupted Sha'Kire builds a summon counter; every 10 kills rolls a 1% chance to awaken Corrupted Sha (77,777 HP, 77 all attributes, casting Disembody for catastrophic magic damage).
New Endgame Accessory & Combat Mechanics:

Amulet of Sha'Kire: New craftable accessory forged from Amulet of the Swordsman and 5 Eyes of Sha'Kire (+50 CON, +30% Counterattack Chance, +30% Counterattack Damage, and Attacks Always Hit; unsellable);
Counterattack Damage Mechanic: Added combat engine support for counterattack damage bonus scaling across equipment, adventurers, and retaliation strikes;
Eye of Sha'Kire: Added rare crafting material dropping from Corrupted Sha'Kire at a 1% rate.
Economy & Anti-Inflation Overhaul — Ruleset & Guidelines:

Economy Rules Documentation: Added docs/economy-rules.md defining empirical vanilla tier benchmarks, drop value ceilings, and mathematical modeling against a 200 rooms/hour baseline, preventing the low-drop-rate illusion from causing idle inflation;
Mandatory Anti-Inflation Gate: Added Gate 11 to .agents/AGENTS.md, requiring explicit Economy Audit Tables in future plans and banning repeatable multi-thousand currency drops.
Economy Balancing — The Slumbering Shallows:

Fish Price Normalization: Realigned raw fish selling prices to standard vanilla food tiers — Perch (20L -> 1L), Blue Trout (36L -> 2L), Angelfish (50L -> 3L), Winged Ray (70L -> 4L), Blue Shark (120L -> 6L), and Magma Shark (300L -> 10L), curbing vendor dumping by 93%;

Bug Fixes & Loot Tables — Wicked Tribute:
Hellish Rations Drop Rate: Fixed an issue with Wicked Tribute's loot table in the Hidden City of Larox, ensuring Hellish Rations reliably drops at its intended 10.7% rate.
Combat Balance & Mechanics — Uncleansable Status Effects:

Uncleansable Debuffs: Certain combat penalties and recoil stuns (such as Serpent Sting) can no longer be cleansed by healers or resisted by high Wisdom, ensuring intended recoil drawbacks cannot be bypassed;
Healer AI Optimization: Cleanse skills and healer targeting now strictly target cleansable debuffs, preventing allies from wasting healing turns trying to cleanse permanent effects;

Expanded Stats & Effects Width: Sited equipment stats and passive effects next to the sprite with nearly double the horizontal rendering space, preventing premature line wrapping on wordy passive text;

Dynamic Barrier Anchoring: Introduced a bottom barrier on the item sprite and stats block to dynamically push the flavor description downward, completely eliminating visual collisions and text collapse regardless of stat list length.

Hard Crowd Control Gate: Entities afflicted by STUN, STUN_NOT_CLEANSABLE, or PETRIFY can no longer perform melee counterattacks or evasive ripostes, closing an exploit where incapacitated units could still counterattack when struck;
On-Hit Stun Suppression: Strikes that inflict Stun on hit immediately suppress counterattack for that strike, preventing stunned defenders from reacting to the attack that incapacitated them;

Doctrine & Corpse Safety: Suppressed forcesTargetToCounterattack (Doctrine of War: Relentless Assault) against incapacitated targets, clamped incapacitated dodge chance to 0%, and prevented counterattacks on foes that died to retaliation damage (thorns/reflection);
Test Suite Verification: Added testCounterattackSuppressionWhileIncapacitated to CombatStatusEffectsTest validating counterattack suppression across all CC conditions.
Economy & Crafting Balancing — Axe Weapon Progression:
Material Quantity Realignment: Balanced raw metal and wood crafting requirements for Black Iron, Frostmetal, Frozen Long, and Primeval axes to match standard weapon tier costs;
Economy Formula Alignment: Normalized base sell prices across all 24 craftable axes strictly following the 1.5x ingredient cost formula, ensuring endgame axes retain their intended economic value.
Combat & Status Effects — Pack Howl & Inspire Rebalance:
New Status Effect (Pack Howl): Introduced Pack Howl granting +20% damage and +15% critical strike chance bonus;
Wolf Minion Skill Integration: Replaced Inspire on wolf pack ability with Pack Howl, distributing localized pack buffs to all surviving allies for 2 turns;
Inspire & Exalt Rebalance: Decoupled critical chance bonus from Inspire to preserve clean vanilla behavior (+25% damage multiplier without crit scaling).
Bug Fixes & Pets — Pet Ability Slot Enforcement (Evo-20):

Species Slot Capacity: Ability slots in the pet shelter now strictly respect species limits (2 slots for Dove, Rat, Lizard; 3 slots for tier-2 pets; 4 slots for pinnacle pets), preventing lower-tier pets from accessing higher slots upon leveling;

UI Visual Feedback: The AUTO-RAID button appears dimmed (40% opacity) on restricted raids, displaying an explanatory toast message when tapped.

Obelisk Shatter Stability: Improved stability when the obelisk breaks and deep-sea reinforcements spawn into the battle.

Chorus the Drowned Tidal Lantern: Restored Tidal Lantern drop weight from 1 to 10 for Chorus the Drowned in The Slumbering Shallows, ensuring intended rare drop availability;
Flavor Text Update: Updated encounter entrance dialogue in The Hunt to reflect the single-enemy Shadow confrontation.

Chorus the Drowned Coin Purse Nerf: Reduced Coin Purse drop weight from 990 to 690 on Chorus the Drowned to improve drop distribution and prevent excessive currency pooling;
Ambient Gathering Coin Purse Nerf: Decreased ambient Coin Purse find chance from 2% down to 0.02% per search in The Slumbering Shallows, rebalancing fishing pond gold generation.

Pet Ability State Isolation: Fixed an issue where switching pet loadouts could leave lingering bonus attributes on pets;
Pet Ability UI Formatting: Enhanced the pet ability selection dialog to clearly display dynamic numbers and ability scaling.
Hero Balance — Eldritch Alchemist Poison Tuning:

Combat Balance — Equipment Scaling for Status Effects:

Frozen Damage Scaling: Fixed an issue where freeze damage bonuses from gear (Frozen Egg Pendant) did not apply to Frozen status ticks;
Regeneration Scaling: Fixed an issue where regeneration gear bonuses (Armor of the Undying, Phylactery) did not apply during turn-by-turn health recovery.

Live Stats Inspection: Enemy inspection dialogs now accurately reflect effective room darkness in real time.

Header Cleanup: Removed redundant version title from settings dialog.
Combat Balance — Outlander Beast Tamer & El Salvador Scaling:

Beast Tamer Apex Summon Capacity: Increased the maximum companion summon cap from 1 to 2 for Tier 7–9 Beast Tamers (Tiger Tamer, Bear Tamer, and Beast Tamer), allowing up to 2 Tigers, Bears, or Owlbears on the battlefield simultaneously;

El Salvador INT Weapon Scaling: Introduced progressive Intelligence weapon attack scaling across the Exile / El Salvador skirmisher line, starting at 1.1 (110%) on T3 Exile and increasing by +0.1 per tier up to 1.7 (170%) on T9 El Salvador (T3 Exile: 1.1, T4 Bandit: 1.2, T5 Vagabond: 1.3, T6 Brigand: 1.4, T7 Renegade: 1.5, T8 Desperado: 1.6, T9 El Salvador: 1.7);
Tooltips & Descriptions Synchronized: Updated Tiger Caller, Bear Caller, and Beast Caller passive descriptions to reflect the new (max 2) pet capacity.
Fix — Outlander Savage Rage Trigger & Buff Icon:

Visual Buff Icon Integration: Hooked up the Rage visual buff icon (2 turns) in combat and damage resolution, ensuring the visual Rage icon appears above the unit and in status inspectors whenever attacking under the passive HP threshold;

Threshold Verification: Preserved the canonical 50% HP threshold for T4–T7 (Berserker, Savage Berserker, Scarlet Berserker, Blood Reaver) and 75% HP threshold for T8–T9 (Crimson Warlord, Avatar of Wrath);

Damage & Stats Deduplication: Guarded damage dealt (+30%) and damage taken (+30%) calculations against double-counting when the RAGE status effect is present, while ensuring raging units retain +100% Attack Speed and +25% Life Steal for the full 2 turns even if healed above the HP threshold.
Combat Balance — Soul Harvest Max Stacks Rebalance:
Capped to Minion Capacity: Reduced the maximum Soul Harvest stacks for the Necromancer / Lich / Black Idol evolution tree to equal each class's active minion cap (maxMinions);

New Stack Limits: Lowered Demilich from 2 down to 1 stack (+15% HP / +10% DMG / -5% DMG taken), Lich & Ancient Lich from 4/6 down to 2 stacks (+30% HP / +20% DMG / -10% DMG taken), and Lord of Decay & Black Idol from 8/10 down to 3 stacks (+45% HP / +30% DMG / -15% DMG taken);
Tooltips Synchronized: Updated Withering Touch III and Withering Link I–IV passive descriptions to match the new stack caps.
Fix — Beast Tamer & Pet Summon Conflict:

Guarded Undead Reanimation: Restricted undead reanimation and Soul Harvest stacks to necromancer classes, preventing non-necromancers (such as Beast Tamers) from having their summon slot hijacked by decaying undead when cursed enemies die;

Pet Targeting Minion Exclusion: Excluded summoned minions from being selected as the target for the Pet Magic trait's TAUNT and CURSE status effect casts, preventing companion focus-fire loops and inadvertent summon replacement.
Fix — Loot Claim & Raid Persistence:
Prevented loot dialog from opening empty when tapped rapidly or after loot was already claimed;
Replaced asynchronous background save on app exit with synchronous save, preventing force-close from discarding unsaved raid attempts;
Relic Slot UI: Hid the relic slot in the adventurer detail dialog for unascended adventurers, preventing it from overlapping with the level text.
Combat Balance — Stat Critical Strike Chance Removed:

Removed Stat Scaling: Removed passive critical strike chance from Dexterity and Intelligence entirely (0% base stat crit), shifting Critical Strike into a dedicated build specialization (via traits, potions, gear, and doctrines) rather than an automatic baseline stat;
Applied Symmetrically: Applied identically to both adventurers and standard enemies to preserve combat parity;
Combat Balance — Celestial Rain Branch Accuracy Rebalance:

Removed Guaranteed Hit ('Always Hits'): Removed innate 100% guaranteed hit from the Marksman, Sureshot, Fury, Hailstorm, Tempest, Hurricane, and Celestial Rain sniper line, restoring evasion counterplay against archers;
+30% Hit Chance Bonus: Granted a flat +30% Hit Chance bonus across all 7 units in the branch;
Keen Vision Tooltip: Updated Keen Vision passive description across all languages to 'Hit chance is increased by 30%';
Focused Trait Synergy: Stacks additively with the Focused trait for up to +55% total hit chance bonus.
Combat Balance — Archer Branch Accuracy Tuning (+15% Hit Chance):
Reduced Branch Hit Chance Bonus: Reduced the innate passive hit chance bonus of the Rider (T3–T9), Poison Bow / Corrosive Wraith (T4–T9), and Alchemist (T6–T9) branches from +25% down to +15%;

Preserved Celestial Rain Identity: The Celestial Rain sniper branch retains its superior +30% hit chance bonus, establishing it as the supreme high-accuracy archer specialization while balancing overall archer reliability against evasive targets;

Passive Tooltips Synchronized: Updated descriptions across all 16 affected passives (Rider I–VII, Poisonous Arrows I–III, Poisonous Blood, Corrosive Blood, and Thaumaturgy I–IV) to reflect the 15% miss chance reduction.
Quality of Life — XP Book Consumption Rework:
Batch Consumption Controls: Added quick stepper buttons (-, +, MAX) and a smooth slider to batch-consume books in bulk;
Full Stack Support: Added instant consumption support for XP Books 1, 2, 3, 10, and C (Ancient XP Book) with live XP preview;
Instant Level Updates: Levels and progression bars update immediately in-place with zero lag or freezing;
Level-Cap Protection: Heroes at max level cannot consume books, and near-cap heroes consume only the exact amount needed.
Mythic Pets — Phoenix (Kiara) Solar Rebirth Rebalance:

Solar Rebirth Trigger Scaling: Rebalanced Phoenix's 5th trait trigger chance from 0.15% per level (15% at Lv 100) down to 0.03% per level (1.5% at Lv 50, 3.0% at Lv 100); because Solar Rebirth checks every combat turn passively without consuming mana, 3.0% at max level ensures healthy combat danger while remaining potent without overshadowing active resurrection skills;

Trait Formatting & Precision: Updated the pet detail inspection view to format Solar Rebirth's proc chance using two decimals (e.g. 0.03% at Lv 1, 1.50% at Lv 50, 3.00% at Lv 100) instead of rounding down to whole integers.
Raids — Auto-Raid Boss Wipe Clean Reset Fix:

Fixed Boss Encounter Ghost State on Auto-Raid Wipe: Addressed an issue where wiping at a boss encounter (such as Sanguine Crucible, The Tower, or other raids) with stop-on-wipe disabled caused the auto-raid re-dispatch cycle to leave previous boss enemies, corpses, fighting queues, and acting states un-cleared; the auto-raid cycle now executes a full, clean reset of all combat and area variables, restores party HP immediately, and resets room progress and events to room 1;

Sanguine Crucible & Raid Lifecycle Hooks: Added onAreaReset lifecycle hook to Area and ensured Sanguine Crucible reliably clears its bossDefeated flag on defeat, respawn, and area reset so subsequent runs never skip rooms or carry over boss state.
Guild Activities — The Siege Defeat & Single-Attempt Enforcement:

Fixed The Siege Infinite Attempts Bug: Addressed an issue where wiping in combat during The Siege failed to trigger onSiegeDefeat, leaving the activity active and granting infinite retries until manually retreating; combat wipes now fire a dedicated defeat event that transitions the status to FAILED and locks the weekly attempt as originally designed;
Wave Cleared Tracking on Wipe: The Siege now accurately records the number of waves cleared upon defeat (progress - 1) in the guild activities state for progression and weekly mission tracking.
Adventurers — Outlander Branch 4: El Salvador (Exiles / Bandits / Frontier Skirmishers):

El Salvador Progression (T3–T9): Fully implemented the Exile line across all tiers (T3 Exile, T4 Bandit, T5 Vagabond, T6 Brigand, T7 Renegade, T8 Desperado, and T9 El Salvador) equipped with Axes/Light Armor and scaling with Dexterity and Constitution (Thief drinker);
New Status Effect — EVASION: Grants a flat additive +25% dodge chance in combat hit calculations, decaying after 1 or 2 turns;
Guaranteed Hit Accuracy: Units with Perceptive Eye (T4–T7) and Omniscient Eye (T8–T9) always hit, completely ignoring target dodge;

Retaliatory Melee Counterattacks: High-dexterity frontier agility triggers immediate melee counterattacks when struck by close-quarters strikes (20% for Focused Eye; 30% for T4/T5 and 40% for T6/T7 Perceptive Eye; 50% for Omniscient Eye);

On-Kill Chains & Evasion Distribution: On slaying an enemy, T6 Brigand and T7 Renegade immediately trigger a bonus basic attack against the next target; T8 Desperado executes a bonus attack and gains EVASION (2 turns); T9 El Salvador executes a bonus attack and grants EVASION (2 turns) to a random living ally;

Frontier Flurries & Lowest-HP Execution: Wild Strikes III & IV unleash 200%/250% physical strikes with 50% follow-up chances; Rapid Exploitation automatically targets the lowest current-HP enemy, striking twice for 175% damage each with a 50% chance for a 3rd strike and a 3.0x critical damage multiplier.
Pets — Mythic Trait Rolling & Progressive Level Unlock:

Universal Trait Rolling for Mythics: Mythic pets (Phoenix and Kitsune) now roll their 4 trait slots like normal pets instead of being restricted to 4 fixed traits; Slot 1 is drawn from the signature Mythic trait pool, while Slots 2, 3, and 4 roll dynamically without repeats from the full pet ability pool;

Progressive Level Unlocks for Kitsune: Standardized Kitsune's trait progression to match Phoenix and normal pets, unlocking Slot 1 at Lv 1, Slot 2 at Lv 21 (level - 20), Slot 3 at Lv 41 (level - 40), and Slot 4 at Lv 61 (level - 60) with standard UI lock indicators, while Kitsune Spirit Blessing continues scaling from Lv 1.
Adventurers — Outlander Branch 3: Datura Hierophant (Nature Magic & Sanguine Druids):

Datura Hierophant Progression (T3–T9): Fully integrated the Druid line across all tiers (T3 Druid, T4 Forest Druid, T5 Gloom Druid, T6 Hemodruid, T7 Sanguine Druid, T8 Bloodthorn Archdruid, and T9 Datura Hierophant) equipped with Staves and Light Armor, scaling with high Intelligence and Constitution (Mage drinker);
New Status Effect — ENTANGLE: Afflicted units cannot dodge (0% dodge chance), deal 20% reduced outgoing damage, and take 2% max HP damage each turn;
New Status Effect — THORNS: Targets take recoil damage equal to (Thorn Stacks)% of damage dealt whenever they hit, decaying by 1 stack at the end of their turn;

Nature Debuff Synergies (Active Skills): Nature's Grasp I–III and Briar's Bramble strike two distinct enemies for 150%/200%/250% magic damage; if the target is already afflicted by any debuff, applies Poison (1 turn), with Briar's Bramble also covering the target with 5 stacks of Thorns;

Affliction Passives & Clarity Rewrite: Implemented Nature's Hand (75% Entangle), Nature's Lash (45% Entangle, 25 Bleed), and Nature's Wrath (independent 35% chance each for Entangle, 40 Bleed, 3 Thorns, and 1-turn Poison on basic attacks), clarifying skill tooltips so each affliction is explicitly stated as rolling independently.
Adventurers — Outlander Branch 2: Beast Tamer & Companion Summons:

Beast Tamer Progression (T2–T9): Fully integrated the Heathen and Tamer line across all tiers (T2 Heathen, T3 Rat Tamer, T4 Cat Tamer, T5 Weasel Tamer, T6 Wolf Tamer, T7 Tiger Tamer, T8 Bear Tamer, and T9 Beast Tamer);

Dynamic % Damage-Dealt Pet Healing: Casting Wild Strikes II heals the Tamer's active bound companion for a percentage of total damage dealt (50% at T7 Tiger Tamer, 100% at T8 Bear Tamer, and 150% at T9 Beast Tamer), naturally scaling with weapon progression, crits, and offensive buffs;

Dedicated Companion Combat Passives: Rats gain 10% (Albino: 15%) Lifesteal; Cats gain +25% (+30%) Dodge & Attack Speed; Weasels gain +40% (+45%) Dodge & Attack Speed; Wolves gain +10% (+15%) damage per living wolf and 10 (15) turns Bleed on-hit; Tigers gain Alert initiative, 100 starting Mana, and 3x (3.5x) Crit Damage; Bears gain 5% (7%) HP regen/turn and 20% (25%) Stun on-hit; Owlbears gain 10% (12%) HP regen/turn and 30% (35%) Stun on-hit;

Dedicated Companion Active Skills: Implemented tactical abilities for all summons: Rabid Bite (Rats: bleed & sustain), Feline Pounce (Cats: guaranteed crit & dodge), Frenzied Flurry (Weasels: 3-hit rapid shred), Pack Howl (Wolves: team damage/crit buff & bite), Predatory Ambush (Tigers: 300% turn-1 burst), Ursine Roar (Bears: taunt, 40% HP shield, stun), and Apex Rampage (Owlbears: taunt, 50% HP shield, 250% AoE cleave);

Natural Companion Equipment: Added dedicated zero-cost minion weapons (Predator Fangs, Wolf Jaws, Tiger Jaws, Ursine Paw, Apex Claws) and armors (Wolf Pelt, Thick Fur, Bear Hide, Primeval Hide) dynamically equipped upon summon without minion decay.
Adventurers — Archer Accuracy Specialization & Focused Passives:
Exclusive Sniper Identity: The Marksman / Celestial Rain branch retains exclusive ownership of Keen Vision ('Attacks always hit the target') as their signature unerring sniper identity;

Focused Accuracy Passives (+25% Hit Chance): The Alchemist, Corrosive Wraith, and Wyrm Rider branches now grant 'Chances to miss reduced by 25%' (additive hit bonus matching the Focused trait) across all their respective passives (Poisonous Arrows I–III, Poisonous Blood, Corrosive Blood, Thaumaturgy I–IV, and Rider I–VII);

Trait Stacking Synergy: This class hit bonus stacks additively with the Focused trait (up to +50% miss reduction total), ensuring reliable status infliction against evasive targets while preserving evasion counterplay;
Updated Skill Tooltips: Synchronized in-game passive descriptions across all 16 affected skills to clearly display the 25% miss chance reduction.
Adventurers — Outlander Branch 1: Avatar of Wrath (Multi-Strike Aggression & Frenzy Mechanics):

Outlander Branch 1 Progression (T2–T9): Fully integrated the Marauder line across all tiers (T2 Marauder, T3 Barbarian, T4 Berserker, T5 Savage Berserker, T6 Scarlet Berserker, T7 Blood Reaver, T8 Crimson Warlord, and T9 Avatar of Wrath) with complete active and passive skills;

Multi-Strike Attack Engine: Implemented diminishing-probability multi-strike active skills: Wild Strikes (125% damage, 50% follow-up), Brutal Strikes (175% damage, 75% -> 50% -> 25% follow-ups), and Brutal Strikes II (225% damage, 75% -> 50% -> 25% follow-ups);

Slaughter & On-Kill Recasts: T7+ active skills feature devastating combat scaling: Bloody Slaughter (225% damage, 85% -> 60% -> 35% follow-ups, 2.0x crit multiplier) and Blessing of Slaughter (250% damage, 85% -> 60% -> 35% follow-ups, 2.0x crit multiplier) instantly recast against another enemy if any strike scores a kill;

New Status Effect — Rage: Added the Rage status effect granting +30% Damage Dealt and +30% Damage Taken; granted party-wide to all living allies for 3 turns upon casting Blessing of Slaughter, and activated conditionally via passive frenzy;

Frenzy Passive Scaling (Attack Speed & Lifesteal): Rage (T2–T3, <=50% HP) grants +50% Attack Speed; Savage Rage (T4–T7, <=50% HP) grants +100% Attack Speed, Rage (+30% dmg dealt / +30% dmg taken), and 25% Lifesteal; Savage Rage II (T8–T9) expands the threshold to <=75% HP with +100% Attack Speed, Rage, and 25% Lifesteal.
Combat System & UI — Universal Combat Stats (Menace, Guard & Special Damage):

New Universal Combat Stat — Menace (Physical & Magic DEF Shred): When landing a damaging hit with a primary attack or active skill, units with Menace shred both Physical Defense and Magic Defense of the enemy by flat DEF for 1 turn (MENACE_SHRED); non-stacking, refreshes duration, takes the highest value, and caster is immune to self-infliction;

New Universal Combat Stat — Guard (Ally Physical & Magic DEF Buff): Whenever a unit with Guard grants beneficial active/passive support (heals, shields, or buffs) to an ally, the receiving ally gains flat Physical Defense and Magic Defense for 1 turn (GUARD_FORTIFIED); non-stacking, refreshes duration, takes the highest value, and provider cannot buff themselves (excluding self-heals, passive regeneration ticks, lifesteal, traits, and equipment procs);

New Universal Combat Stat — Special Damage Multiplier: Introduced Special Damage (defaults to 100%), scaling true damage procs against adjacent secondary enemies from primary damage dealt; deals 0 damage against solo targets, requires successful primary hit, and never triggers status effects or on-hit loops;

Unit Detail Dialog Placement: Added Menace (below Status Immunity) and Guard (below Darkness Damage) to Page 2 Secondary Stats, and Special Damage (alongside Attack Speed) to Page 3 Tertiary Stats with complete help tooltips.
Combat UI & Battle Logs — Dedicated Reaction Combat Logs (Vaporize & Thermal Shock):
Dedicated Battle Log Messages: Replaced generic damage dealt combat logs for Alchemist Chemical Reactions with custom themed battle log entries for Vaporize and Thermal Shock;
Vaporize Combat Feedback: Combat logs now explicitly announce Vaporize triggering AoE magic blasts across enemies (e.g. '[Unit] triggers Vaporize, dealing [Damage] magic damage to [Target].');

Thermal Shock Combat Feedback: Combat logs now clearly report Thermal Shock shattering frozen targets with hybrid damage (e.g. '[Unit] shatters the freeze with Thermal Shock, dealing [Damage] damage to [Target].');
Catalytic Barrage Integration: Grand Detonation during Catalytic Barrage now properly logs each individual reaction blast across all affected enemies.
Combat UI & Battle Logs — Status Effect Descriptions & Stack Tracking Cleanup:

Concise Battle Log Descriptions: Replaced multi-sentence tooltip descriptions in combat logs with concise, grammatically natural descriptors for 10 status effects (Corrosion, Enfeeble, Entangle, Radiant Blessing, Solar Rebirth, Brittle Toxin, Sinister Curse, Soul Harvest, Sanguine Fervor, and Bloodflame);

Live Stack Tracking in Battle Logs: When stacking buffs and debuffs (Corrosion, Enfeeble, Sanguine Fervor, Soul Harvest) gain multiple stacks, the battle log now dynamically appends the stack counter (e.g. 'is corroded (x3) for 3 turns', 'is empowered by Sanguine Fervor (x4)');
Status Inspection Dialog Stacks: Fixed stack count display in the Live Battle Status Effects inspector for permanent stacking buffs (Sanguine Fervor and Soul Harvest).
Adventurers — Wraith & Corrosive Wraith Evolution Line Rebalance (Corrosion & Enfeeble Debuffers):

Progressive Hybrid Weapon Scaling (T6–T9): Bow attacks scale with both DEX and INT starting at Plague Spreader (+10% INT per tier: T6 100% DEX + 30% INT, T7 100% DEX + 40% INT, T8 100% DEX + 50% INT, and T9 100% DEX + 60% INT), matching the parallel Alchemist branch progression;

Dedicated Stackable Debuff — Corrosion: Attacks have an on-hit chance (T8: 10%, T9: 20%) to inflict Corrosion for 3 turns, increasing all incoming damage by +4% per stack (T8 Wraith cap: 3 stacks / +12% damage taken; T9 Corrosive Wraith cap: 5 stacks / +20% damage taken);

Dedicated Stackable Debuff — Enfeeble: Attacks have an on-hit chance (T8: 20%, T9: 40%) to inflict Enfeeble for 2 turns, draining target's core attributes by -5% CON, DEX, and INT per stack (T8 Wraith cap: 1 stack / -5%; T9 Corrosive Wraith cap: 3 stacks / -15%);
Focused Barrage Multi-Hit Synergy: Firing two arrows at each enemy provides rapid multi-hit rolls to spread and refresh Corrosion and Enfeeble across all enemies;
Status Immunities: Wraith and Corrosive Wraith gain innate immunity to both Poison and Corrosion.
Pet System — Inspection & Preview in Team Dispatch & Pet Selection:

Pet Preview on Long-Press: Holding (long-pressing) any pet in the pet selection dialog or holding the assigned pet slot in team setup opens the pet detail dialog with haptic feedback, allowing players to inspect abilities, stats, level, and descriptions before dispatching;
Safe Read-Only Mode: When inspecting pets from team setup, destructive actions (Merge and Set Free) are hidden to prevent accidental changes while assembling dungeon or raid teams.
Adventurers — Alchemist Evolution Line Rebalance (Tiered Chemical Reactions & Catalytic Barrage):
Tiered Chemical Reactions Engine (Thaumaturgy I–IV): Basic attacks and skill shots react dynamically with elemental statuses, unlocking and strengthening across tiers:
• Vaporize: Attacking an Ablaze target detonates an AoE magic blast to all enemies, scaling progressively (T6: 0.6x INT, T7: 0.8x INT, T8: 1.0x INT, T9: 1.2x INT);
• Thermal Shock (Unlocked at T7): Attacking a Frozen target shatters freeze for hybrid bonus damage (T7: +100% Phys / +100% Mag, T8: +125% Phys / +125% Mag, T9: +150% Phys / +150% Mag);
• Brittle Toxin (Unlocked at T9): Attacking a Poisoned target applies Brittle Toxin (+20% damage taken for 2 turns; strictly non-stacking, refreshes duration);

Active Skill — Catalytic Barrage: T9 Eldritch Alchemist fires a 3-shot volley triggering passive reactions on hit, followed by an unconditional Grand Detonation applying Vaporize, Brittle Toxin, and Thermal Shock across all living enemies;
Feeble Tether Synergy: When reanimated via Feeble Tether, Catalytic Barrage gains a 10.0x damage amplification across both barrage shots and Grand Detonation;
Progressive Hybrid Weapon Scaling: Added dual DEX + INT scaling across the branch: T6 (100% DEX + 30% INT), T7 (100% DEX + 40% INT), T8 (100% DEX + 50% INT), and T9 (100% DEX + 60% INT).
UI & Quality of Life — Scrollable Skill Descriptions:
Scrollable Skill Detail Dialog: The skill detail description is now scrollable, ensuring long skill explanations (such as Thaumaturgy and chemical reactions) are fully readable across all devices.
Adventurers — Whisper Evolution Line Rebalance (Phantom Duelist & Precision Executioner):
Branch Scope: Rebalance starts at Tier 5 (Spire Initiate) through Tier 9 (Whisper), leaving Tier 4 Assassin untouched to preserve vanilla branching into Red Stalker;
Innate Phantom Avoidance: Granted +15% innate dodge chance across T5–T9 (Spire Initiate through Whisper) while retaining trap sabotage capability (saboteur = true);

Tiered Offensive Passives: Replaced vanilla trap passives with Phantom Instinct I–III (T5–T7) and Phantom Lethality I–II (T8–T9) featuring systematic lowest % HP enemy targeting, 20% to 40% enemy DEF ignore, and up to +45% to +70% damage amplification scaled by the target's missing health;

Eclipse Scaling Progression: Active Eclipse skills (I–IV) now scale damage progressively (+10% per tier: 110%, 120%, 130%, 140%) with 3.0x critical strike amplification, instant recast on kill, and execution thresholds (10%, 15%, 20%, 25%);
Relative % HP Targeting: Both basic attacks and Eclipse skills reliably prioritize the lowest percentage HP enemy to systematically finish wounded targets.
Adventurers — Wyrm Rider Evolution Line Rebalance (Beastmaster & Dragon Rider Overhaul):

Dedicated Mount Active Skills: Replaced generic arrow barrages with true mount abilities across all tiers — Savage Pounce (Wolf Rider: 250% Physical + Stun), Frenzied Rend (Worg Rider: 3x 200% Physical + Bleed 20), Caustic Deluge (Spitfang Rider: 3x 220% Magic + Poison 3 turns), Incinerate (Drake Rider: 220% Magic AoE + Ablaze), Incinerate II (Golden Drake Rider: 300% Magic AoE + Ablaze 2 turns), and Sublimate (Wyrm Rider: 2x 200% Magic AoE + Ablaze 2 turns & Frozen 2 turns);
Living Companion Synergy: All mount active skills and end-of-turn attacks properly benefit from living companion damage amplification (+% bonus pet/companion damage from gear);

Stat-Scaled End-of-Turn Attacks: Replaced flat static mount damage with scaling physical follow-up attacks based directly on Rider DEX & INT (T4: 60% DEX, T5: 80% DEX, T6: 60% DEX + 60% INT, T7: 75% DEX + 75% INT, T8: 90% DEX + 90% INT, T9: 120% DEX + 120% INT);

Targeted Follow-Up & Range Separation: Mount end-of-turn attacks focus the single enemy that the Rider attacked that turn; attacks are Melee for T4–T5 (Wolf & Worg) and Ranged for T6–T9 (Spitfang, Drakes & Wyrm);
Status Afflictions: Mount attacks inflict Bleed (10 to 30 stacks), with Spitfang Rider inflicting Poison (3 turns);
Hybrid Weapon Scaling: Rider bow attacks gain dual scaling across the line (100% DEX + 30%–50% INT).
Adventurers — Black Idol Evolution Line Rebalance (Dread Lich & Soul Harvester):

Skill-Based Minion Summoning: Active skills (Curse I–V) now directly summon undead servants into combat without requiring enemy deaths; when at maximum minion capacity, casts mend and heal all active minions for 35% Max HP;

Expanded Summon Capacity: Max minion capacity scales across tiers — 1 minion for Necromancer (T4) & Demilich (T5), 2 minions for Lich (T6) & Ancient Lich (T7), and 3 minions for Lord of Decay (T8) & Black Idol (T9);
New Minion Companion: Introduced Bone Abomination as the hulking frontline minion servant for Tier 8 Lord of Decay;
Soul Tether Damage Redirection: Lich line units redirect a portion of all damage taken directly to living minions (20% at T4, 25% at T5, 30% at T6, 35% at T7, 40% at T8, up to 45% at T9);

Soul Harvest Status Effect: When cursed enemies die, all active summoned minions absorb their essence, gaining permanent stacking buffs (+15% Max HP with immediate heal, +10% Damage Dealt, -5% Damage Taken per stack), capped based on summoner tier (up to 10 stacks at T9);

Tiered Passives (Withering Touch I–III & Withering Link I–IV): Structured explicit tiered passives displaying exact lifesteal, damage redirection percentages (20%–45%), and Soul Harvest max stack caps across T3–T9;

Tier-Scaled Minion Decay: Reduced undead minion decay from vanilla 25% down to a tier-scaled rate — Zombie (20%), Skeleton (18%), Bone Horror (16%), Bone Nightmare (14%), Bone Abomination (12%), and Bone Hydra (10%).
Adventurers — Single-Target Burst Mage Line (Apprentice Branch):
New Evolution Branch: Adept now branches into the Arcanist tree as a dedicated 3rd promotion choice alongside Fire Wizard and Dark Sorcerer;
7 Evolution Tiers: Added Arcanist (T3), Spellweaver (T4), Aether Mage (T5), Aether Archmage (T6), Disintegrator (T7), Grand Magus (T8), and Singularity Magus (T9);

Active Burst Spells: Features focused single-target arcane damage scaling progressively across all tiers — Energy Burst III (500%), Arcane Blast I–III (600%–800%), and Disintegrate I–III (1000%–3000%);
Recast Probability: Disintegrate (T7–T9) introduces pinnacle recast chance (20% / 25% / 30%) to immediately cast a second blast upon execution;
Aether Resonance Passive: Unified passive family (I–VII) granting +10% up to +70% enemy Armor & Magic Defense penetration (+10% per tier);
Boss Priority & Threat Bypass: Units with Aether Resonance completely bypass enemy taunts and the threat weighting system, locking onto Boss-type enemies when present.
Combat Engine — Boss Classification System:
Boss Property Integration: Introduced boss classification for specialized targeting and encounter dynamics;
Boss Flagging: Slime King and Archmagus Valthex are officially flagged as Boss-type enemies for priority targeting.
Adventurers — Alert+ Trait Upgrade:
Added Alert+ Trait: Alert can now be evolved using Evolution Vial 24 (Evo-24) into its permanent PLUS form, Alert+;
Initiative Retained: characters with Alert+ maintain guaranteed turn-0 initiative at the start of combat, identical to Alert;
First Strike Amplification: grants +20% Basic Atk Amp on the very first hit landed in each combat encounter.
Equipment — Scarlet Armor Rebalance:
Scarlet Sigil: changed from +20% crit chance to +20% Skill Amp;
Scarlet Oni: changed from +18% crit chance, +5% crit dmg into +27% damage dealt;
Scarlet Oni Juggernaut: changed from +30% crit chance, +35% crit dmg into +51% damage dealt.
Combat Engine — Enemy Defense Rebalance & Immunities:
Stone Shaman & Archmagus Valthex: increased base MDEF to 450 to maintain their intended 90% magic damage reduction under the universal diminishing returns formula;
Magic Armor: scaled base DEF and MDEF to 150 (75% damage reduction, preserving its heavy construct resilience);
Obsidian Golem: properly wired up native Deflect Magic passive in combat so all magical damage is reduced to 1 as documented;
Necrolith: set damage taken modifier to 0% (indestructible until Kabar the Rotten is defeated);
High-Defense Scaling: updated Bloodstone Colossus (200 DEF / 80%), Trolls (117 DEF / 70%), Knight Slime (75 DEF / 60%), and Crimson Acolyte (75 MDEF / 60%) to match intended vanilla reduction tiers.
Traveling Merchant — Unique Item Recovery & Duplication Fix:

Fixed Phantom Evolved Item Re-offers: Purged all ancestor items when evaluating unique drops (e.g. owning or seeing Sha reliably clears Divine Larvae, Divine Embryo, and Divine Zygote even if intermediate recipe records were missing);

Hierarchical Ownership Check: possessing an evolved boss accessory (like Sha or Amulet of the Swordsman) now automatically satisfies possession of all predecessor stages, preventing intermediate items from falsely appearing in the Traveling Merchant for 1 gem;

Expanded Storage Scans: added active market listings, unclaimed sold market items, and dismissed adventurers to the possession scanner to eliminate duplicate generation when unique gear is temporarily listed or stored on retired heroes.
Guild Activities — Weekly Siege Reset Fix:

Fixed Locale-Dependent Siege Rollover: corrected the week boundary calculation to lock to the game engine's Sunday 00:00:00 boundary regardless of device locale; players in Monday-first locales (Europe, Asia, UK, etc.) now correctly reset their weekly Siege attempt on Sunday midnight matching the in-game countdown timer;

Fixed Unattached Fragment State Loss: decoupled triesAvailable updates from Android view binding availability in both The Siege and The Hunt so weekly/daily attempts reliably reset in memory even during background ticks or before navigating to the Guild Activities tab;
Instant Startup Catch-Up: Added immediate activity checks on game startup so overdue daily and weekly resets apply the moment the save file loads.
Combat Engine — Hemorrhage & Thousand Cuts Fixes:

Fixed Silent Hemorrhage Logs: Hemorrhage damage logs are no longer suppressed behind verbose logging; burst procs now always display in standard battle logs ('[Target] hemorrhaged. It lost [Dmg] damage!');

Fixed Critical Hemorrhage Rate: corrected the critical roll calculation (which compared random against [0..100] instead of [0..1], reducing crit chance by 100x); Hemorrhage now properly rolls the inflicter's full critical chance and pet Savage super-crit tier;
Floating Damage & Death Animation: Hemorrhage damage now triggers visual floating combat text and properly triggers instant death when lethal;
Updated Skill Tooltips: Thousand Cuts and Thousand Cuts II descriptions now clearly explain both the Bleed stack application and the instant Hemorrhage burst mechanic.
Skill Phrasing Improvements:
Updated tooltips for Whip and Tear, Extirpate, Obliterate, Annihilate, and Flay to clarify melee and ranged damage components instead of ambiguous 'Range is always melee' phrasing.
Rogue Rebalance — Deadly Finesse Flurry & Bleed Synergy:
Reworked the Deadly Finesse passive line (Meat Carver, Wounds Weaver, Hellish Sculptor, Spirit Engraver) into a dedicated flurry-of-cuts archetype focused on rapid bleed stacking;
Deadly Finesse I (Meat Carver): +50% Attack Speed (50% chance for a 2nd strike), -25% Basic Attack Amp;
Deadly Finesse II (Wounds Weaver): +75% Attack Speed (75% chance for a 2nd strike), -35% Basic Attack Amp;
Deadly Finesse III (Hellish Sculptor & Spirit Engraver): +100% Attack Speed (guaranteed 2 strikes every turn), -50% Basic Attack Amp;

Bleed & Skill Synergies: Spirit Engraver now reliably applies 120 Bleed per turn with basic attacks, rapidly shredding enemy armor while active skill (Thousand Cuts II) damage remains at 100% full power via Skill Amp;
Dungeon Utility: Retains full saboteur trap-disarming utility across all tiers.
Combat & Status Inspector Enhancements:

Fixed 999+ Bleed Stacks Display: resolved an issue where reaching 999+ Bleed charges caused the live Battle Status Effects inspector to display 'Permanent' and the combat battle log to omit stack counts ('[Enemy] is bleeding'); both now properly display the full charge count (e.g. 1000+ turns/charges left);
Status Effects Inspector Tabbed Layout: added top tab navigation ([Enemies], [Allies], [All]) defaulting to Enemies, eliminating tedious scrolling past 14 raid allies to inspect enemy debuffs;
Hide Unaffected Units Toggle: added a 'Hide units without effects' checkbox in the Status Effects inspector to filter out units with zero active buffs or debuffs for an ultra-clean view.
New Accessory — Bloodstone Claws:
Bloodstone Claws (Accessory): +25 Constitution, +26 Dexterity, +20% Attack Speed, and Bonus Action: Bleed 60 (inflicts 60 stacks of Bleed on melee attacks);
Crafting Recipe: 1x Kabelian Claws + 2x Scarlet Debris (dropped by the Bloodstone Colossus in The Sanguine Crucible).
Raid & Dungeon Corrections:

Fixed The Lost Expedition Avatar of the Ancient Multi-Spawn: fixed an issue where empty narrative rooms fell through to the boss encounter return, causing the Avatar of the Ancient to be fought up to 9 times in a single raid run; empty rooms now cleanly return no enemies;
Eternal Battlefield Darkness Restored: restored dungeon darkness to 20, recovering the vanilla value lost during the initial Java-to-Kotlin migration;

Celestial Mothership Encounters Aligned: added missing combat encounters for room 11 (5-unit Destroyer/Lancer fleet) and room 13 (5 Celestial Destroyers), and adjusted room 12/15 door encounters to match the intended encounter table.
UI & Layout Refinements:

Entity Detail Page 3 Layout: reorganized tertiary stats into clean, balanced 5-row pairs matching Page 1 — Row 3: Attack Speed (alone), Row 4: Damage Dealt & Basic Atk Amp, Row 5: Damage Taken & Skill Amp;
Renamed 'Normal Atk Amp' to 'Basic Atk Amp' for clearer in-game terminology.
Defense & Magic Defense Rework — universal damage mitigation formula (DEF * 100) / (DEF + 50)%:
Replaced linear 1 DEF = 1% damage reduction with an asymptotic diminishing-returns curve: Damage Reduction = (DEF * 100) / (DEF + 50)%, applied universally to both adventurers and enemies;

Linear Effective HP: every 1 point of DEF/MDEF grants exactly +2% of Max HP as Effective HP across all levels (50 DEF = 50%, 100 DEF = 66.7%, 200 DEF = 80%), eliminating total invulnerability while ensuring every stat point remains valuable;
Armor Penetration & Bleed Shred: penetration and bleed shred reduce the target's effective DEF prior to the formula, preserving their role as potent anti-tank attributes;
Incorporeal Passive: Will-o'-the-Wisp explicitly reduces all physical damage taken to 1 (preserving its intended physical damage immunity under the universal formula).
Attack Speed System — unified turn action scaling (Default: 100%):

Replaced hardcoded 'Attacks twice / thrice' effects on weapons (Cursed Bow and Infernal Bow: +100% Attack Speed, Celestial Bow: +200% Attack Speed) and passives (Berserker Rage) with unified percentage Attack Speed stats and updated item descriptions;

Scaling Formula: Every +100% Attack Speed guarantees +1 extra basic attack per round, while partial percentages grant a chance to strike again (e.g. 150% = 1 guaranteed attack + 50% chance for a 2nd strike);
Safeguards: Extra attacks generated by Attack Speed are strictly basic attacks that never generate mana, preserving active skill cadence without double mana accumulation;
S.P.I.D.E.R Accessory: Retains its unique mechanical melee appendage strike as an independent accessory proc, stacking cleanly alongside weapon Attack Speed;
UI: Restored missing Intelligence stat display and added live Attack Speed display to Page 3 with explanatory help tooltips;

Enemy Integration: enabled Page 3 inspection on enemies displaying live Attack Speed (e.g. Berserkers below 50% HP or dual-striking foes scale to 200%+) with interactive tooltips, and unified enemy combat extra attacks with the Attack Speed formula.
Damage Systems — universal damage scaling & amplification (Baseline: 100%):

Damage Dealt: unifies outgoing damage scaling into a single dynamic stat incorporating traits (Reckless +15%, Lone Wolf +5% per empty/fallen ally), doctrines (Ragebound +35%, Eye for an Eye +50% below 50% HP), buffs (Frenzy +30%, Anointed +25%, Sanguine Fervor +5%/stack, Delirium +100%), debuffs (Entangle -20%), and equipment;

Damage Taken: unifies incoming damage vulnerability and damage reduction into a single additive stat incorporating traits (Dragon Blood -9% to -18%, Reckless +15%), doctrines (Ragebound +35%), debuffs (Sinister Curse +50%, Petrify +10%), and equipment (e.g. Dragon Blood Ascended Lv45 with Ragebound and Sinister Curse = 167% Damage Taken);
Normal Attack Amplification: Scales basic weapon attacks (including extra strikes from Attack Speed) and basic single-target round heals;
Skill Amplification: Scales active skill attacks and active skill heals;

UI & Modding Architecture: added Damage Dealt, Damage Taken, Normal Attack Amp, and Skill Amp to Page 3 of the hero and enemy inspection dialogs with interactive tooltips, pre-wired into Entity, Adventurer, Equipment, and Doctrine layers.
Fixed the doctrine dialog failing to open / choose doctrines (regression from 1.3.17.3's UI change):

Reverted the doctrine ability rows from horizontal ScrollViews back to the original (known-good) horizontal LinearLayouts — the ScrollView container silently crashed the dialog at open time, blocking both choosing a doctrine from the Temple list and opening a doctrine from the adventurer dialog;

Moved Verdant Briars (Doctrine of Control) from Row 2 to Row 3 so no row exceeds the 4-card layout limit (Control is now rows 1 / 4 / 2) — its 1 LP cost, 5% / 7% / 10% Entangle-on-hit effect and 2-turn duration are unchanged;
Added a regression unit test asserting every doctrine keeps at most 4 abilities per row.
Temple Doctrine Expansion — every doctrine gains a 7th ability node (new nodes never replace existing ones; all existing investments remain fully intact):
Doctrine of Affliction - Bloodletting (Capstone): basic attacks consume 5% / 10% / 15% Max HP (non-lethal, down to 1 HP) and inflict Bleed equal to the HP consumed on hit;
Doctrine of War - Titans Might (Capstone): converts 50% of Constitution into bonus Physical Damage;
Doctrine of Illusion - Evasive Riposte (Specialization): successfully dodging an attack counterattacks the attacker for 50% / 100% / 150% Physical Damage;

Doctrine of Control - Verdant Briars (Specialization, 1 LP/level): attacks have a 5% / 10% / 15% chance to Entangle the target for 2 turns — Entangled units cannot dodge, deal 20% less damage and take 2% max HP damage per turn;
Doctrine of Grace - Sympathetic Ward (Capstone): healing an ally also heals this unit for 10% / 20% / 30% of the amount healed;
Doctrine of Knowledge - Accelerated Mastery (Capstone): active skills have a 10% / 20% / 30% chance to instantly refund all mana when cast;
Doctrine of Ruin - Annihilation (Capstone): critical hits deal +30% / +60% / +90% bonus damage, but the unit takes 5% max HP recoil damage on crit and cannot lifesteal;
Doctrine of Fortitude - Armor Master (Specialization): increases the Defense and Magic Defense granted by equipped Armor by 20% / 40% / 60% (floored);
UI: doctrine ability cards use 4dp padding so 4-card rows fit compact screens, and ability rows scroll horizontally if a row exceeds 4 cards;
Saves: doctrines now persist the 7th and 8th ability slots (l7/l8) with full backward compatibility — legacy saves default them to 0; save tooling updated.
Temple Doctrine Rebalances:
Exalted Health (Doctrine of Knowledge): buffed from +25 to +50 HP per level (up to +250 HP at max level);
Exalted Dexterity, Intelligence & Constitution (Doctrine of Knowledge): buffed from +3 to +5 per level (up to +25 at max level);
Conditioned Reflexes (Doctrine of War): counterattack chance buffed from +10% to +15% per level (up to +45% at max level);
Selfless Spirit (Doctrine of Grace): increased max level from 4 to 5 (up to +50% healing modifier);
Divine Intervention (Doctrine of Grace): increased max level from 3 to 5 (up to +5% bonus resurrection chance);
False Life (Doctrine of Illusion): increased max level from 2 to 3 (up to +12% cheat death chance).

Dragon Blood & Troll Blood Ascension Synergy: rank-scaling traits now grant an Ascension bonus (+9 effective rank) so Ascended adventurers are strictly superior to unascended adventurers across all tiers. Dragon Blood grants 1% damage reduction per tier + 9% if ascended (1%-9% unascended, 10%-18% ascended). Troll Blood grants 0.5% max HP regeneration per tier + 4.5% if ascended (0.5%-4.5% unascended, 5.0%-9.0% ascended).

Rare Drop Claim Highlight: claiming loot from dungeon and raid chests now visually highlights rare items with a radiant gold border and warm luminous gold background in the claim dialog, while maintaining the standard appearance in warehouse storage.

Dungeon & Raid Team Gear Loadouts: saving a team for a dungeon or raid now also records each hero's equipped weapon, armor and accessory; loading that team (or starting/continuing an Auto-Raid) automatically re-equips the saved loadout through a conflict-safe resolver — items already equipped are kept, pieces in warehouse storage swap 1-for-1 without ever exceeding capacity, idle guild members safely yield their gear (falling back to their default weapon or an empty slot), while pieces worn by heroes actively exploring another area are protected and reported in the "Unavailable" dialog. Gear snapshots persist in the save file (fully backwards compatible with older saves), are re-applied on every Auto-Raid dispatch, and are cleaned up when a hero is dismissed.
New weapon type: Axe — a hybrid melee family scaling with 100% Constitution and 100% Intelligence (base damage variance ±20%) added alongside Sword, Bow, Dagger and Staff:

Full 26-axe catalog implemented — starter Stick plus Copper, Iron, Undead, Golden, Corrupted, Enforcer's, Zapper, Black Iron, Abyssal Greataxe, Frostmetal, Frozen Long, Obsidian, Vampire, Unholy, Primeval, Celestial, Animated, Enchanted Cleaver, Wicked Cleaver, Berserker's, Molten Slayer, Omni-Sever, Cursed Long, Infernal Long and Abhorrent Long Axe, each with stats, prices, sprites, crafting recipes and drop sources;
Enemy drops: Corrupted Axe now drops from the Imperial Enforcer at 0.1% and Berserker's Axe from the Lost Lands Berserker at 3%;

Combat engine: weapons now support probabilistic end-of-turn actions (Berserker's/Molten Slayer 10% extra attack) and multiple simultaneous on-hit status effects (Zapper stun, Frozen Long freeze, Omni-Sever freeze/ablaze/stun, Cursed/Infernal/Abhorrent Long poisons and burns);
Cleaver variants add extreme damage spread (±30% Enchanted, ±50% Wicked with +10% dodge), and axe wielders scale 100% CON + 100% INT by default.

Fixed Blackwater Port never spawning Mysterious Tentacles during idle: restored the kraken encounter sequence on empty rooms so idle exploration correctly advances and triggers the kraken event, alongside solo Tentacle encounters and corrected room thresholds.
Reworked weapon damage scaling architecture to support hybrid-scaling adventurer classes:

Fixed the Holy Knight / Angel of War branch (HolyKnight, Paladin, Templar, Inquisitor, Justiciar, AngelOfWar) failing to scale with Intelligence: weapon damage modifiers now sum all channelled stats instead of discarding off-stats, allowing their 70% INT sword scaling to function correctly;
Weapon types and Adventurer stat scalings are now archetype-aware, ensuring unused stats default to 0% so standard classes maintain pure single-stat or dual-stat scaling;
